(The Other [[Netherlands national football team|Oranje]]) | founded = {{Start date and age|1977|df=y}} | ground = [[Kras Stadion]] | capacity = 6,984 | chairman = [[Cees Driebergen]] | manager = [[Erwin van de Looi]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Dutch football updater|Volendam}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|Volendam2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|Volendam3}} | current = 2024–25 FC Volendam season | pattern_la1 = _volendam2324h | pattern_b1 = _volendam2324h | pattern_ra1 = _volendam2324h | pattern_sh1 = _volendam2324h | pattern_so1 = _volendam2324h | leftarm1 = F97500 | body1 = F97500 | rightarm1 = F97500 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = F97500 | pattern_la2 = _volendam2324a | pattern_b2 = _volendam2324a | pattern_ra2 = _volendam2324a | pattern_sh2 = _volendam2324a | pattern_so2 = _volendam2324al | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 9CE0FF | socks2 = 000000 | website = {{Official URL}} }} '''Football Club Volendam''' ({{IPA|nl|ˌvoːlə(n)ˈdɑm}}) is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Volendam]], Netherlands. They play in the [[Eerste Divisie]], the second tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], following relegation from the [[Eredivisie]] in the [[2025–26 Eredivisie|2025–26 season]]. Nicknamed "de Palingboeren", the club was founded as Victoria in 1920, changed its name to RKSV Volendam in 1923 and emerged as an exclusively professional club, FC Volendam, in 1977, following a split from its parent club. The team plays its home matches in the 6,984-capacity [[Kras Stadion]], where it has been based since 1975. The club has a reputation as the ''heen-en-weer club'' ("the back-and-forth club") due to its numerous [[Promotion and relegation|promotions and relegations]] between the first and second tiers of [[Football in the Netherlands|Dutch football]]. They have achieved eleven promotions to the [[Eredivisie]]; a record.{{cite web |title=FC Volendam gaat op voor tiende promotie |url=https://www.ad.nl/nederlands-voetbal/fc-volendam-gaat-op-voor-tiende-promotie~aa2d3fa4/ |publisher=[[Algemeen Dagblad]] |access-date=6 September 2020 |language=nl |date=3 May 2013 |archive-date=11 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230311004653/https://www.ad.nl/nederlands-voetbal/fc-volendam-gaat-op-voor-tiende-promotie~aa2d3fa4/ |url-status=live }} The botter (a fishing boat - Volendam is a fishing village)[[:nl:Botter|nl.wikipedia.org Botter]]{{Circular reference|date=September 2025}} with which the players are honored on the occasion of promotion is called the Heen en Weer and is number XI due to the most recent promotion in 2025.[https://nos.nl/artikel/2563646-elfde-promotie-is-een-feit-fc-volendam-keert-terug-in-de-eredivisie NOS.NL Elfde promotie is een feit: FC Volendam keert terug in de eredivisie] Volendam also reached two [[KNVB Cup]] finals: in [[KNVB Cup#Past finals|1957–58]] and [[KNVB Cup 1994-95|1994–95]]. Both resulted in losses to [[Rotterdam]]-based clubs: [[Sparta Rotterdam|Sparta]] and [[Feyenoord]], respectively.{{cite web |title=(VIDEO) Terugblik bekerfinale FC Volendam – Feyenoord 1995 |url=https://fcvolendam.nl/nieuws/video-terugblik-bekerfinale-fc-volendam-feyenoord-1995/ |publisher=FC Volendam |access-date=6 September 2020 |date=24 January 2017 |archive-date=12 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240712164104/https://fcvolendam.nl/nieuws/video-terugblik-bekerfinale-fc-volendam-feyenoord-1995/ |url-status=live }}"}}
